method: Two concurrent workers sharing CPUs 0,1,2,3 (different physical cores), each with 300 actual reloads and 256 versus 192 MiB Serial heaps, both Xms32m and fifteen-second trimming. All other local benchmarks/builds stopped. Cores are not exclusive; host load is uncontrolled. PSS is sampled sequentially across both live workers once per second. Max observed sum is not an exact peak. End-of-workload CPU excludes shutdown; group elapsed includes startup, shutdown and up to one sampling interval of polling delay. No NMT, forced checkpoint GC or profiler.

gcSummary.note: Pauses cover worker lifetime, including startup. GC CPU fields are rounded diagnostic samples; use paired total worker CPU to measure net savings.
